title: Max Hawkins - Mapping Activity Space - Adventures in Randomized Living
speaker: Max Hawkins
talk_title: Mapping Activity Space - Adventures in Randomized Living
description:
This talk is from the 2019 Roguelike Celebration - find out more at https://roguelike.club/event2019.html

Max Hawkins is an artist and computer scientist based in Los Angeles. For two years he let a randomized computer algorithm make all of his decisions including where to live, what to wear, who to talk to, and what to eat.
